Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Moor Park and Amersham due to train cancellations. After the 23:52 departure from Amersham, the last southbound train will be at 00:40 and will terminate at Rickmansworth. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Severe delays due to an earlier points failure at Brixton. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, South Western Railway and Southeastern.

Weaver.reason: Weaver Line: Until Thursday 16th July, there will be no service between Hackney Downs and Chingford while we conduct urgent repairs to the track following a line side fire near Wood Street. Please use London Underground and London Buses to complete your journey. SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.
